content: Add a repository-local session-guidance workflow in which a specialist can publish a bounded direction or candidate patch to an active session, the owning agent validates and dispositions it at a control boundary, and raw guidance is removed instead of becoming a second archive.

Placed reusable guidance behavior in agent/skills/session-guidance while keeping raw packets session-local, transient, and outside Git. Domain skills, current source, tests, and canonical constraints retain technical authority; only the session owner applies source changes and records a material disposition.

Content revision 6ddd90779bac0b4a7e3826c3c8770351ed5a9866 passed the 16-case guidance CLI suite, 81-case record-validator suite, skill validation and routing checks, full dev CTest 63/63, and nix flake check. Independent forward use passed, and independent review closed all deletion, recovery, rename, and path-containment findings.
